description:
“Hello, Geurim. How long has it been since you slept with me and dumped me?”

But then… right before I came to Korea, the man I accidentally, impulsively, almost as if possessed, ended up disgracefully sleeping with moved in right across from me!

Mo Tae-kyung. My brother’s longtime friend and the childhood friend who had witnessed every embarrassing moment of my past.

“Didn’t you think about me?”

When I didn’t answer, he swallowed my stubbornly sealed lips.

My lips parted, and Mo Tae-kyung’s tongue slipped in.

Damn it. I cursed endlessly in my head. Damn it, damn it, damn it!

I couldn’t help it. Mo Tae-kyung was unbelievably good at kissing. Really, truly, insanely good.

So that was why, that day too….
